Dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379)
Thanks for the [estimate](../others.html#160) of the copyrights, which is a good deal what I expected, as I thought they must be more valuable to me than to anyone else.
I cannot think what [Clay](../others.html#173) is about. A month ago he wrote to me in a great hurry for more copy of the [Cameos](../books.html#124) saying you wanted the third volume finished, I sent him up at once all but the last two or three chapters which are now ready, and nothing more have I heard of them - no proofs nor any sign of his going on.
I do not think it was quite settled what I was to have for [My Young Alcides](../books.html#112). I should be glad to know.

Yours truly

C M Yonge
